links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of AI DR screening vs ophthalmologist reference standard in local patients
links.effect: Patient-level referable disease: sensitivity 87.5% (95% CI 71.9-95.0), specificity 66.2% (95% CI 54.3-76.3); DME sensitivity 100%, specificity 81.9%.
links.quote: CARA demonstrated a sensitivity of 87.5% (95% CI 71.9-95.0) and specificity of 66.2% (95% CI 54.3-76.3) for detecting referable disease at the patient level.

screen.reason: Prospective validation of a commercial/semi-automated AI system (CARA) for diabetic retinopathy screening in clinical practice comparing AI to standard ophthalmologic examination.
